pattern.description: Inside the fixed app window beside the presenter, the MCP Servers page slides out and the Rules page slides in from the right (tab label changes to 'Rules'), timed to the word 'rules'.
pattern.why_premium: The window chrome and gradient frame stay locked while only the page content swaps with a smooth eased slide, so feature-to-feature navigation reads like a real product and lands exactly on the narrated word.

build_hint.gsap: Window overflow hidden; gsap.timeline().to(oldPage, {xPercent: -30, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).fromTo(newPage, {xPercent: 100}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '<'); swap tab label at the midpoint.
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); old page translateX(-30%*p) opacity 1-p; new page translateX((1-p)*100%) inside an overflow:hidden window.

notes: Mid-burst frames show the Rules list overlapping the MCP list from the right; exact direction and whether the old page also moves is hard to tell at filmstrip resolution. Could alternatively be classed as layout_reframe. Presenter motion (b12) is footage, not graphics.
